clauses.text:
By virtue of and pursuant to the au­
thority vested in me by the act of August  
1, 1914, 38 Stat. 609, 623 (U. S. C., title  
19, sec. 2), it is ordered that the designa­
tion of Gateway, Montana, as a customs  
port of entry in Customs Collection Dis­
trict No. 33 (Montana and Idaho), be,  
and it is hereby, revoked.
This order shall become effective at the  
close of business on March 31, 1939.
